title: Duplicate request rejection and refusal recovery pass; pre-submit form refresh unresolved
details: Two independent fixtures tested on dev. In the visible-browser run, first UI POST /entries returned HTTP 201, ref QS-2026-M-137-001, entry 01a1601e-c722-75bf-8254-a9b33c50120c, with an Idempotency-Key. The second already-open form still displayed Submit after an 8.5-second foreground wait. Clicking Submit there returned HTTP 409 / competition.already_entered and automatically navigated to https://app.dev.worldsurfleague.com/athlete-registration/events/01a1601d-fc7d-7108-bfc3-827ea10aabcf/entry/QS-2026-M-137-001. A separate distinct API submission also returned HTTP 409; GET /entries/options returned existingEntry with the same reference/entry ID. Backend rejection and redirect-after-refusal are solved. The automatic focus-return behavior is not certified: sampled browser telemetry reported BOTH tabs visible/focused, so an authentic background-to-visible transition was not established. Do not call the focus-only part definitively fixed or definitively regressed from this run. Manual tab-switch verification remains.
